Lowetsani tsiku la Hijri kuti muwone Arafah, An-Nahr ndi masiku a Tashreeq
Lowetsani tsiku lovomerezeka la Hijri. Chaka kuyambira 1300 mpaka 1600, mwezi kuyambira 1 mpaka 12, tsiku kuyambira 1 mpaka 30.

Lowetsani tsiku lililonse la Hijri (kapena sungani tsiku lomwe lilipo) kuti mupeze nthawi yomweyo masiku a Haji mchaka chake: tsiku la Arafah (9 Dhul-Hijjah), tsiku la An-Nahr (10 Dhul-Hijjah) ndi masiku a Tashreeq (11, 12 ndi 13 Dhul-Hijjah), lililonse lokhala ndi nthawi yake yofanana ndi ya Gregorian.
Chipilala chachikulu kwambiri: imani ku Arafah kuyambira masana mpaka kulowa kwa dzuwa, kupemphera kwambiri, takbir ndi tahlil. Mtumiki (SAW) adati: "Haji ndi Arafa."
Eid al-Adha: mwala Jamarat al-Aqabah wokhala ndi miyala isanu ndi iwiri, perekani nsembe, meta kapena chenga, kenako chitani Tawaf al-Ifadah ndi Sai.
Chidziwitso chatsiku ndi tsiku chomwe chimakukumbutsani za mwambo womwe unafunidwa panthawi yake m\'masiku a Hajj (8-13 Dhul-Hijjah)
Chidziwitso chatsiku ndi tsiku chomwe chimakukumbutsani za mwambo womwe unafunidwa panthawi yake m\'masiku a Hajj (8-13 Dhul-Hijjah)
Sunnat yatsiku lino: lowani mu ihram, pitani ku Mina ndi kugona kumeneko, ndikubwereza Talbiyah "Labbayk Allahumma labbayk", ndipo pempherani kumeneko mofupikitsa popanda kuphatikiza.
Ponyani miyala ya Jamarat itatu masana: yaing’ono, kenako yapakati, kenako yaikulu, timiyala 7 iliyonse uku mukunena takbir, kupemphera pambuyo yaing’ono ndi yapakati.
Bwerezani kugenda Jamarat atatu masana monga dzulo. Amene akufuna kufulumira, achoke ku Mina dzuwa lisanalowe; amene akhala usiku ndi kuponya miyala tsiku lachitatu.
Mangani Jamarat atatu masana, kenako malizani Haji ndi Tawaf yotsanzikana pochoka ku Makka. Allah akulandireni Haji yanu.

Kufotokozera mwatsatanetsatane za Haji ndi Umrah: tanthauzo ndi ziweruzo, mitundu ya miyambo, mawaqit, miyambo munjira yanzeru zake ndi zomwe anganene pa station iliyonse, zoletsedwa za ihram, ndi mapembedzero. Sankhani gawo lomwe mukufuna kufufuza.

Mtumiki (ﷺ) anati: “Allah ali ndi mayina makumi asanu ndi anayi mphambu asanu ndi anayi (100) kuchepera limodzi; amene wawawerenga adzalowa ku Paradiso.” Dinani dzina lililonse kuti muwerenge kumasulira kwake, matanthauzo ake ndi umboni wochokera mu Quran.
